stem.text: Which gland category releases secretions through a duct onto an epithelial surface?

options.label: C
options.text: A gland defined solely by deep anatomical location

options.label: D
options.text: A gland defined solely by superficial anatomical location

key_explanation.text: Option A, an exocrine gland, sends its secretion through a duct onto an epithelial surface. The route of secretion defines this category.

strongest_distractor.text: B, an endocrine gland, releases hormones without a duct to an epithelial surface. C and D use anatomical depth, which does not define the endocrine-exocrine distinction.
